summary: Deployment-readiness verification of cla-spa30 (CLA Aesthetics & Wellness). Backend: 29/29 pytest tests passing including public content endpoints, auth (register/login/me/refresh), leads, portal intake CRUD, change password, admin (clients/revenue/payments), CMS CRUD (news/offers/generic), Emergent LLM chat, and Stripe test-mode membership checkout session creation. Frontend: landing page renders all sections, admin login + CRM dashboard load, register→portal redirect works, invalid login shows error. TWO frontend issues found: (1) Concierge widget not mounted (imports missing in App.js) so camille-* and lead-* testids referenced in the review request don't exist in the DOM; (2) Portal page has no change-password UI (backend endpoint works).

ui_bugs.issue: Concierge component is defined in /app/frontend/src/components/Concierge.jsx but never imported or rendered anywhere. As a result, the AI concierge chat (camille-launcher, camille-panel, camille-input, camille-send) AND the public lead form (lead-name, lead-phone, lead-interest, lead-submit) are completely absent from the DOM on all pages. Fix: import Concierge in App.js and render <Concierge /> inside AuthProvider/ContentProvider so it appears on every page (or at least on Home).
Change password UI is not present on /portal (no change-password-form / change-password-submit testids). Backend PUT /api/auth/password works fine. Add a change-password form section/tab on Portal.

integration_issues.flow: Public lead capture from landing page
integration_issues.issue: Home landing page has no visible lead/contact form (Contact section only has phone/email/address links). Lead capture form was expected via the Concierge widget, which is not mounted. POST /api/leads works via API only.

issues: An admin promo banner text 'TEST_Offer — d' from seeded test data appears at the top of the public landing page; delete TEST_ offer/news items before publishing.

action_items: Import and render <Concierge /> in /app/frontend/src/App.js (inside providers, outside <Routes>) so the chat widget and public lead form appear on every page.

Add change-password form to /app/frontend/src/pages/Portal.jsx with data-testid='change-password-form' and submit button data-testid='change-password-submit' calling PUT /api/auth/password with {current_password, new_password}.
Clean seeded TEST_ demo data (TEST_Offer, TEST_Lead) before pointing user to Publish.
Optionally add a standalone lead form in the Contact section as a fallback if Concierge is dismissed.
critical_code_review_comments: Concierge.jsx exists but is dead code — must be wired into App.js.
server.py is 1724 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, cms, payments, chat) for maintainability.
PUT /api/auth/password uses field name `current_password` (fine) — Portal UI must match; not old_password.
POST /api/chat requires session_id in body — frontend must generate/persist a session id per user session.
Stripe key sk_test_emergent works with the emergentintegrations helper and produces a checkout URL; do NOT switch to live keys without user's real Stripe secret.
Admin `/admin/news`, `/admin/offers`, and generic `/admin/cms/{kind}` all return `{ok:true, item:{...}}` shape — frontend admin code must consume `item` field (already does).

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (core pages load, admin/auth flows work; Concierge + change-password UI missing)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@cla-wellness.com / ClaAdmin2026! (verified working). Client accounts created dynamically per test.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_Lead via POST /api/leads and 1 test client via POST /api/auth/register during automated testing. Admin CMS CRUD tests self-cleanup their items (create+delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. After main agent (E1) wires <Concierge /> into App.js and adds change-password UI to Portal, re-run frontend flow: (1) landing page lead form submit → check POST /api/leads network call & Concierge shows sent state; (2) camille-launcher opens panel; camille-send POSTs /api/chat with session_id and displays LLM reply (may take 5-10s); (3) /portal change-password-submit sends {current_password,new_password} to /api/auth/password. Backend endpoints and admin dashboard need no further changes.
rca of the issue: Concierge component was authored but the developer never added `import Concierge from '@/components/Concierge'` and `<Concierge />` in App.js (or Home.jsx). Reproduction: open landing page, run document.querySelector('[data-testid=camille-launcher]') → null. Mitigation: import in App.js above <BrowserRouter> children and render once so it overlays every route.
